fusions.name: Torpid Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a cold link at an enemy up to 5 tiles away that deals 4 damage, up to 1.3 times that at full reach, and it moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Stilling Coil
fusions.desc: Coils a ring of links around you that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns each for 1 second, leaving each [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Dead Still
fusions.desc: Veils you for 9 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 11% faster. Attacking breaks the veil.

fusions.name: Basking Weight
fusions.desc: In daylight, your armour rises by 12%.
